title: Elliott Smith: Either/Or
description: His 1997 masterpiece: the title, the songs and the film that carried them to the world.

cards.prompt: In what year was Either/Or released?
cards.details: The same year Good Will Hunting came out, which was perfect timing.
It was his last album for the label before moving to DreamWorks for XO.

cards.prompt: Either/Or is named after a book by which Danish philosopher?
cards.details: Kierkegaard's Either/Or (1843) weighs a life of pleasure against a life of duty. Smith studied philosophy in college.
A hushed, ominous opener that sets the mood straight away.

cards.prompt: Which Either/Or song about drinking, a quiet late-night ballad, appears in Good Will Hunting?
cards.details: Perhaps his most famous song: tender and devastating at the same time.

cards.prompt: Which Either/Or song is named after the Spanish word in a Californian city's name?
cards.details: A fingerpicked song about Los Angeles and the music industry, and another one used in Good Will Hunting.

cards.prompt: Which hopeful, short song closes Either/Or?
cards.details: A rare upbeat ending about new love. It's also in Good Will Hunting.

cards.prompt: Which Either/Or song is named after Portland's big annual flower festival parade?
cards.details: Portland is the "City of Roses". He sings about watching the parade go by.

cards.prompt: Which Either/Or song shares its name with a California city and a Portland street?
cards.details: One of the album's most loved songs, built on a gently rolling guitar part.

cards.prompt: Complete the Either/Or song title: "Ballad of Big ___"
cards.details: "Ballad of Big Nothing" is a brisk, bitter song about doing what you want with nothing to show for it.

cards.prompt: Which Either/Or song title is about self-image: "___ of Me"?
cards.details: "Pictures of Me" is one of the album's more full-band, rocking moments.

cards.prompt: In which anniversary year did Either/Or get an expanded reissue with live and unreleased tracks?
cards.details: Its 20th anniversary, with remastered audio and extra songs.
